purpose: Teach: 顔ぶれ/時限/入れれ/次号/迂回/臨み/思い浮かべる/長め

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期の顔ぶれ、今でも忘れない。
lines.en: I still remember the faces from when we started.
lines.style: Measured, reflective. Soft opening. Gaze inward—not at the listener. Weight of years beneath a steady voice. No rush.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。時限的な危機を乗り越えてきました。
lines.en: Yes. We've weathered those critical periods.
lines.style: Respectful, grounded. Direct eye contact held. Firm but not stiff. Acknowledging without excess—the brevity of a son listening to his father.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 手間と時間、もう少し入れれば、より良くなる。
lines.en: With more time and care, things could still improve.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Lean forward slightly—not urgency, but importance. Even pacing. The tone of someone who has thought long about this.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。次号の業界誌、創業者として、寄稿予定です。
lines.en: Yes. I'm planning to write a piece for the industry magazine next month, as the founder.
lines.style: Steady commitment. Clear articulation of the plan. Pride without boasting. A son making his intentions known to someone whose opinion matters.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 問題を迂回せず、正面から取り組め。
lines.en: Don't sidestep the problems. Face them head-on.
lines.style: Firmer now. Direct, almost pointed—not harsh, but the voice of someone used to being heeded. Each phrase lands. No softening.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。新時代に臨み、覚悟、新たにします。
lines.en: Yes. I'm preparing myself anew for this new chapter.
lines.style: Solemn undertaking. Steady breath. The weight of promise in the words. Humble but certain—not asking permission, declaring resolve.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業の喜び、ふと思い浮かべる時間、大切にしろ。
lines.en: Treasure those moments when the joy of building suddenly comes back to you.
lines.style: Gentle wisdom. Slow, deliberate pacing. Almost tender—a father speaking what matters. Space between phrases. Voice lowers at the close.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。寿命を長めに、頑張ってください、お父さん。
lines.en: Yes. Keep going for a long time yet, Dad.
lines.style: Warm, direct address. Voice softens on 「お父さん」. Not instruction now—affection masked as agreement. The son's own wish beneath the words.
